description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This is a pivotal leadership opportunity to oversee all aspects of facility management, ensuring the highest standards of resident care, regulatory compliance, and operational efficiency.The successful candidate will be responsible for fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff, driving continuous improvement initiatives, and managing financial performance. Join a team committed to providing exceptional care and making a significant impact on the lives of residents.
requirements: Current and valid state licensure as a Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA)
Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, or a related field
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as an LNHA in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting
Comprehensive knowledge of state and federal regulations governing skilled nursing facilities
Demonstrated leadership, financial management, and interpersonal communication skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $115,000 to $145,000 annually, based on experience.
